note: Import the .png — it carries its own resolution and bit depth. Set the XYZ scale above and lift the actor by unrealLandscapeZOffsetUU. Z scale reproduces the -60..180 m range: one unit of landscape Z scale spans 512 m of the 16-bit range, so scale = range_m * 100 / 512. Sea level lands at 16383 of 65535.
